title: Dramatiq user guide (paraphrase)
text: Dramatiq processes messages with RabbitMQ or Redis brokers. Messages are acknowledged after the actor finishes, which gives at-least-once delivery; the documentation recommends making actors idempotent. Failed messages are retried with exponential backoff by default.
